tasks.gr7-whole-numbers-t1: Topic: Whole numbers. Cover place value, factors and multiples, prime factorisation, HCF, LCM, ratio, and rate. Ask Grade 7 learners to simplify ratios, compare rates, and solve contextual whole-number problems using efficient strategies.
tasks.gr7-exponents-t1: Topic: Exponents. Cover power notation, square and cube numbers, and basic exponent laws for multiplication and division with equal bases. Ask Grade 7 learners to evaluate powers, simplify expressions, and recognise equivalent exponential forms.
tasks.gr7-construction-of-geometric-figures-t1: Topic: Construction of geometric figures. Cover ruler, compass, and protractor use for constructing angles, triangles, and quadrilaterals. Ask Grade 7 learners to choose correct instruments and steps, and interpret properties from accurate constructions.
tasks.gr7-geometry-of-2d-shapes-and-straight-l: Topic: Geometry of 2D shapes and straight lines. Cover properties of triangles, quadrilaterals, and polygons, plus line-angle relationships. Ask Grade 7 learners to classify shapes, determine missing angles, and justify reasoning using geometry facts.
